fill in the blank she was tired that she.whyCorrect: "so ... that" is the correlative construction for a result: so + adjective + that + clause (so tired that she could not walk).

wrong.B: "very tired that ..." is ungrammatical; "very" does not take a that-clause.
wrong.C: "too" takes the "too ... to" pattern (too tired to walk), not "too ... that".
wrong.D: "such" takes a noun (such a tired person), not an adjective alone.

wrong.A: 45 km/h incorrectly assumes a different weighting; the correct harmonic mean yields 48 km/h.

wrong.D: 55 km/h has no mathematical basis for this scenario.

what is the process by which water moves.whyCorrect: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from leaves creating a negative pressure that pulls water upward through xylem from roots.

wrong.A: Respiration is cellular energy release from glucose, not water transport.

wrong.D: Evaporation is the phase change of water to vapor; transpiration includes this but also the cohesive pull through the plant.
